column1: # The source-layout round's gate exceptions (docs/source-layout-round.md 7a, the owner's calls 8 and 10): a
# function may differ only in a named class listed here. Classes: inline (x86_64; the compiler
# inlined, or stopped inlining, a moved or copied helper because its callers in the file changed);
# low32-site (x86_64; Low32()'s failure message names another file, line or
# function: __FILE__, __LINE__ and the __builtin_FUNCTION() default argument, which a move or a
# rename of the caller changes); data-layout (both widths, call 10; a promoted variable is placed elsewhere
# in .data/.bss, so a neighbouring file-local and its readers' reference to it differ; a row may name a data
# or bss symbol); x64-indirect (x86_64 only, call 10; a folded internal function pointer is called through
# once external; a row names the caller or the pointer, which reads NEW). The i686 gate passes --exception-classes data-layout, so its code stays exact but for that
# class. A new class needs the coordinator's entry in the round doc with its first case. Read by
